sloka: व्यक्तं दैवादहं मन्ये राघवस्य विना भवम् ।वैदेह्या सारथे नित्यं दैवं हि दुरतिक्रमम् ।। ७.५०.४ ॥
transliteration: vyaktaṁ daivādahaṁ manye rāghavasya vinā bhavam ।vaidehyā sārathe nityaṁ daivaṁ hi duratikramam ।। 7.50.4 ॥

translations.english: O charioteer, I clearly believe that Rama's separation from Sita is due to destiny, for destiny is always insurmountable.
